Market today: The S&P 500 just broke crucial support, signaling broader market weakness. Geopolitical tensions (Trump/Xi/Putin, China AI risks) are high, directly impacting your tech/chip-heavy, margin-leveraged book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-78.17%), MUU (-61.79%), and SMCI (-44.99%) are bleeding heavily. Your leveraged ETFs are decaying and amplifying these drops, especially on margin. CRWD is a strong performer, up 25.52%.

Watch: Closely monitor the S&P 500's reaction to the broken support. Also, track developments from the Trump/Xi/Putin meeting and any further news on China's access to AI chips.

Bottom line: This is a high-risk environment; prioritize managing deep losses and reducing leveraged exposure.
plays: Trim CRWD: Consider taking some profits on CRWD (up 25.52%) to reduce overall portfolio risk, especially with the S&P breaking support.
Review SOXL stop: Your SOXL stop at 200 is far from the current price of 49.07. Re-evaluate this stop to prevent further deep losses on this leveraged ETF.
Consider SOXS long: Given the S&P broke support and chip sector risks, consider a long position in SOXS (inverse semiconductor ETF) at entry 58.71-58.65 with a stop at 58.16, as per your scanner.
